$comment: The source of sf-display-settings' element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes rule.js, studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json, probe.json and smart.manifest.json from it). A new component, made against standard simai.smart-component 1.3.15 and vocabulary 1.1.5: owner decision C196 (2026-11-15; research ui-control control/research/2026-11-15-accessibility-worldwide.md, prototype prototypes/accessibility-panel-study.html#q-a11y-panel).

label.summary: The trigger's text and the panel's name. Not set: «Настройки отображения» («Display settings»). A Russian site that is asked for the button by name writes «Версия для слабовидящих»

layout.summary: disclosure: a button that opens the panel in place under it (aria-expanded), Escape closes it and the focus goes back to the button; panel: the panel stands open, with no button (a page of its own, a footer)

open.summary: Whether the panel of layout disclosure is open; the button turns it, Escape closes it

show-font.summary: Offer the font group: the site's font, sans serif or serif (the system's --sf-sans and --sf-serif). Off by default: the site's author turns it on

show-links.summary: Offer «Подчёркивать ссылки». Off by default: the site's author turns it on. Inside a colour scheme links are always underlined

settings.summary: What the person chose, as SF.displaySettings keeps it: {scheme, textScale, textSpacing, images, motion, font, links}. Read-only; the choice lives in this browser (localStorage sf-display-settings) and on the root attributes

setting.summary: The field that moved (scheme, textScale, textSpacing, images, motion, font, links), or reset.

change.summary: A person changed a setting or chose «Обычная версия»: the fact, sent after the root shows it and the browser keeps it. Nothing is sent anywhere; a page that wants to know listens here

reset.summary: «Обычная версия»: every setting back to the site's own look, the kept choice removed; sends change with setting reset. refused {reason: unchanged} when nothing was changed

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The trigger is sf-button's native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls naming the panel. The panel is a group named by label; each setting is a group named by its word («Текст», «Цвет», …) of toggle buttons with aria-pressed (one pressed per group), the text steps are «А−» / «А+» buttons named «Текст меньше» / «Текст больше» with the size in a polite live region. Under forced-colors the colour group's buttons are disabled and the group says «Цвета задаёт система». Nothing says or implies that the site meets a standard (C196 (6)).

x-summary: How a person wants the site shown -- text 100–200 %, a colour scheme, wider spacing, images in colour, grey or hidden with their text, motion stopped, «Обычная версия» -- kept in this browser only and applied by core on every page. Replaces the legacy low-vision version (.sf-special). Promises no conformance.

x-source.brief: Owner decision C196 (2026-11-15, decisions.md rows C195, C196): the world set of display settings, schemes from the palette, the device first, the name sf-display-settings, the legacy special as an alias until 2027-01-01. Not doing: read aloud, a dyslexia font, a reading ruler, disability profiles, auto-fixing the site.

x-decisions: name: sf-display-settings («Настройки отображения»), family settings (C196 (4)); the trigger's text is the label setting, «Версия для слабовидящих» on a Russian site that is asked for it.

the set (C196 (1)): text 100/125/150/175/200 % (a step is a share of the browser's own size on <html>, so it multiplies the person's setting), colour (the site's or one of five schemes), spacing normal or wider (WCAG 1.4.12 values), images colour / greyscale / hidden with the text alternative in place, motion as on the device or stopped, «Обычная версия»; the author turns on the font (site / sans / serif) and «Подчёркивать ссылки». Not: read aloud, a dyslexia font, a reading ruler, disability profiles, auto-fixing.

the device first (C196 (3), (5)): under forced-colors the colour group is disabled and says «Цвета задаёт система»; when the device already reduces motion the motion group says so; core answers prefers-contrast and prefers-reduced-transparency on every site, with or without this panel.

storage (C196 (5)): the choice is kept in localStorage sf-display-settings only, no cookie, nothing sent; core (core/js/display-settings.js) applies it on every page of the site, so the panel is needed only where a person changes it.

look (prototype accessibility-panel-study, panel B): a card place (surface-card, outline-variant edge, surface radius, padding space-1/2); groups in a wrapping row, 16 apart (space-1), inside a group the label and the buttons 8 apart (space-1/3); every choice is an outline sf-button on-surface of size 1/2 with the pressed look (C12) on the chosen one; «Обычная версия» a ghost button, its word alone (no icon: the panel asks nothing of the icon service, so a page with it makes no request but its own). The trigger is the same outline button.
honesty (C196 (6)): no text, attribute or name of the component says that the site is accessible or meets a standard.

legacy (C196 (7)): the special module (class sf-special, SF4 panel) is kept for the Bitrix templates until 2027-01-01, its sheet replaced by an alias to the core schemes and settings (journal display-settings-replaces-special).

version 1.1.1 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.1.0 on origin/fix/layer-order-c273): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

version 1.1.2 (written on the branch as 1.0.1; 2026-11-17, owner decision C268; one above origin/main): a patch, nothing to see. The template writes pointer-events-none, the class named as the property, for pointer-event-none, its former name until 2027-01-01 (journal class-c268-pointer-events), so a page of the component no longer notes a deprecation. Settings, values, events, keys and drawing unchanged.

version 1.1.3 (written on the branch as 1.1.0; 2026-11-17): a minor (owner decision C273, utility or component). The component's fill, edge colour, text colour and the place roles it declares stand in the new cascade layer sf.paint, under the utilities, so a bg-*, border-* or color-* class on it or on one of its parts now paints it; its size, padding, radius, height and edge width stay in sf.components, over the utilities. The look without a utility is unchanged (the built sheets hold the same declarations, the paint ones in sf.paint). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.1.4 (2026-11-18, group build 13; above every origin branch): a patch, words only. The C278 language packs (feat/lang-packs-c278 in fix/lang-follow, and the group build's words for the merged branches) gave this component its language files in de, es, fr, it, pt-br, ja, ko, zh-hans and ar; the pair before carried them under the same number. No behaviour, setting, key or Russian and English word changes.

version 1.1.5 (2026-11-19, group build 14; above every origin branch): a patch, probe only. fix/manifest-probes-round (ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-19-manifest-probes-round) made the manifest probe (examples.json and the probe.json generated from it) follow the decided behaviour (p2-scheme p3-text p4-author-options); the pair before carried the old checks under the same number. No code, setting, word or drawing changes.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-22, feat/display-settings-ds for group build 17; above every origin branch): a minor (DEV letter msg-8977f46e, DS-1..DS-5 of ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-22-display-settings-roles). layout=disclosure opens the panel as a layer under its button (position absolute, z-index --sf-layer--popover, the overlay shadow), as wide as its groups up to --sf-measure-96 and the screen less --sf-space-1 on each side, moved in by the script when it would cross the screen's or a scrolling parent's edge: in the flow of a content-sized slot (sf-header-site's tools) it grew to one 2651 px row and folded the header's menu for good. Core (core.styles, fingerprint only) makes the spacing, the hidden and grey pictures win over site CSS (!important, the visitor's overrides), gives the spacing to every element and form field, draws a 1 px text-tone edge on every popup, menu, tooltip and window in a scheme, and remaps the media, veil and chart roles to the scheme's tones. Settings, values, events, keys and words unchanged; layout=panel unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-22, feat/display-settings-ds for group build 17; above 1.2.0, the highest on every origin branch): a minor, a look (DEV acceptance of DS-1..DS-5, return DSA-3, ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-22-ds-roles-acceptance; evidence control/evidence/2026-11-22-dsa). The disclosure trigger carries the eye glyph (icon-start visibility) and sf-button's shrink="icon" (C370); the panel folds it to that glyph -- a square of the button's height, ghost, its name and a tooltip with the label -- when the whole button crosses the screen or the content box of a box around it, measuring the whole button with the fold lifted in the same task. In sf-header-site's tools at 390 with the text at 200 % the button was 389 px in a 314 px row and the page 557 px wide (WCAG 1.4.10). A bar's own request (sf-header-site collapse auto sets data-shrunk) is left to the bar. Settings, values, events, keys and words unchanged; layout=panel unchanged.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: claiming that the site meets an accessibility standard
sending the person's choice to a server
reading aloud, fixing markup or guessing alt text

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-display-settings where a site offers its visitors display settings -- a school, a municipal or a public site that is asked for «версия для слабовидящих», or any site that wants a text size and contrast switch for people who do not know the browser's.
do_not: Do not say the site is accessible or compliant next to it; the panel is a comfort, the main site must meet WCAG itself
Do not add read-aloud, a dyslexia font or disability profiles around it
Do not keep the choice in a cookie or send it to a server; core keeps it in this browser

keyboard: Tab reaches the trigger and every button of the panel; Enter or Space presses it
Escape in an open disclosure panel closes it and returns the focus to the trigger
accessibility.focus: The trigger keeps the focus when it opens the panel; Escape returns the focus to it. A pressed choice keeps the focus.
